summary: The candidate is test-only hardening that correctly replaces the unified-memory cases' averaged KL threshold with value-exact logprob comparison. It rejects the independently reproduced 5.0000069648240756e-11 counterexample and a smaller numerical difference, but neither tree backend has a supported end-to-end Inkling result and no FULL/SWA/MAMBA restoration guard has revert-then-red or fault-injection proof.

tests.what_was_measured: At recorded base 358c163, unequal logprobs produced nonzero KL 5.0000069648240756e-11 and were accepted by the averaged 1e-9 threshold.
Base collected 18 tests; exact candidate collected 24, confirming discovery of the six new unified-memory cases only.
At exact candidate commit, all three exact-oracle unit tests passed.

tests.command: independent compare_kl_divergence adversarial script with require_exact=True
tests.what_was_measured: The candidate rejected the reported nonzero KL and a 1e-12 numerical difference. NumPy value equality accepted signed-zero and dtype-only equal values, both of which have zero KL.
Inkling resolved from /job/repo and failed in its NVIDIA CUTE attention import with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cutlass' on AMD gfx950/ROCm.

The actual Python unified-memory Inkling test failed during server/model initialization before inference or KL measurement; missing CUTLASS caused the Inkling model import to be ignored and model registration failed.

gpu_execution_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) was assigned. The server process reached GPU-oriented startup but failed before an inference request, so no GPU numerical output or exact-zero KL was measured.
native_rebuild_evidence: The candidate changes Python test utilities, Python test registration, and reports only; no native source or library changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
remaining_counterexamples: The six unified-memory tests are collected but still have no supported end-to-end Inkling result for either the Python or Rust tree backend.
There is no revert-then-red or targeted fault-injection evidence showing that unified-memory FULL restoration is detected.
There is no revert-then-red or targeted fault-injection evidence showing that unified-memory SWA restoration is detected.
There is no revert-then-red or targeted fault-injection evidence showing that unified-memory MAMBA restoration is detected.
remaining_limitations: The host is AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, while Inkling imports a NVIDIA CUTE/CUTLASS path; cutlass is unavailable.
No qualifying end-to-end Inkling inference completed and no independent GPU numerical reference was produced.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify Inkling's combined FULL/SWA/MAMBA architecture or state-restoration semantics.
The candidate's comparator enforces NumPy value equality, not literal representation equality; this distinction does not create a nonzero-KL escape for numeric logprobs.
